meta.description: Fast CLI/Python queries to 20+ bioinformatics databases. Use for quick lookups: gene info, BLAST/BLAT, viral sequence downloads, AlphaFold structures, enrichment analysis, OpenTargets, COSMIC, CELLxGENE, and 8cube mouse specificity/expression data. Best for interactive exploration and simple queries.

scientific_integrity.detail: No fabrication; queries real bioinformatics databases with proper attribution and version pinning

practice_boundaries.detail: Appropriate scope for bioinformatics data retrieval; clearly documents when to use alternatives like biopython or bioservices

methodological_ground.detail: Based on established genomic databases (Ensembl, NCBI, AlphaFold, etc.) with proper citation

code_usability.detail: Complete working examples for all 23 modules with proper error handling patterns

functional_suitability.note: Comprehensive coverage of 23 modules across 6 categories; complete CLI and Python interfaces; excellent module catalog and reference documentation

reliability.note: Good database versioning and pinning guidance (gget==0.30.5); documents database update risks; minor: could benefit from more explicit retry/rate-limit guidance

performance_context.note: Well-organized 154-line SKILL.md with excellent progressive disclosure through 3 reference files; clear module categories; efficient structure

agent_usability.note: Excellent trigger description with specific database and use-case patterns; clear when-to-use guidance; explicit alternatives (biopython, bioservices); perfect agent discoverability

human_usability.note: Excellent installation instructions with uv and virtual environment guidance; clear quick start; comprehensive Python version compatibility notes

security.note: Good credential handling for COSMIC and OpenAI; environment variable guidance; warnings against hardcoding; minor: no explicit HTTPS-only mention for remote queries

maintainability.note: Perfect: version 1.4, clear author, pinned dependencies (gget==0.30.5), official citation, license, and compatibility notes

agent_specific.note: Strong composability with other biology skills; good progressive disclosure with 3 reference files; idempotent queries; minor: workflows could be more explicit about multi-module pipelines
